visualCharacteristics.purpose: Doctor search band: free-text term plus a location dropdown that submits a GET request to the Mayo Clinic doctor results page
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width photo band (white 70% wash) with a centered H2 and a round blue magnifier badge to its left; below, uppercase field labels over a square text field, a square location select and a solid blue SEARCH button in one row on desktop (stacked on tablet and mobile); centered Search Tips link near the bottom. On mobile the photo is replaced by a light-blue background.

contentPattern.structure: Background photo; then H2 heading; then Field label | placeholder; then Location label | default option text (all locations); then one row per location: shown text | query value; then link to the results page (form action); then optional Search Tips link
contentPattern.description: Interactive search form; cannot be authored as default content. Sends searchterm={term} (required, trimmed) and locations={value} (omitted when the default option is chosen). No type-ahead.
contentPattern.blockContent: Find a doctor search: term field, location select, SEARCH button, Search Tips link
table: Link to the results page, e.g. https://www.mayoclinic.org/appointments/find-a-doctor/search-results

usage: Photo band with a heading and a doctor search form (term + location) that submits to an external or on-site results page.
reuseGuidance: Use when a search needs a second filter (a select) and a visible submit button, with query names searchterm and locations. Rows by kind, in this order: picture row (background); heading row; two-cell text rows: the first is field label | placeholder, the second is select label | default option text, each further one is an option (shown text | query value; value defaults to the shown text); first link row is the form action; second link row is a helper link (e.g. Search Tips). For a single field without a select, use search-conditions.
